summary.ordinary_reading: The ordinary focus is a compact scene of runners whose audible breath marks their running, with no supplied identity for the runners.
coexisting_readings: The following clauses sharpen that scene into a coordinated kinetic sequence of kindling, dawn-raid imagery, raised dust, and entry into a gathered group.

The later assertions can make the outer exertion a foil for human ingratitude and intense attachment to good, then move from visible action to disclosure of buried and inner contents under divine knowledge.
The ethical overstepping/raid and material scorching/blackening readings remain live exploratory alternatives because their branch images are anchored in the focus and activated by nearby context.
unresolved_limits: All mapped variants are unranked; the packet does not identify the agents, historical setting, or an explicit causal relation across the clauses.
No source gaps are recorded, but the غ ي ر mapping itself supplies no raid branch here; the dawn-raid nuance is carried by the ص ب ح branch and sequence and must not be promoted to certainty.
The focus-to-context relations are reconstructed inferences from adjacency, branch images, and sequence, not claims imported from outside evidence.
